description:
On the Twin Cast podcast, the Twins break down why understanding your net sheet and listing agreement is critical before putting your home on the market.

These documents show you the full picture — what to expect during the process and how much money you may walk away with at closing.

It also helps you prepare for real scenarios, including when there isn’t enough equity and you may need to bring money to closing.

Selling isn’t just about listing your home — it’s about knowing your numbers and making informed decisions.

If you're selling in Central Texas real estate, this step gives you clarity and confidence before you move forward.

Follow for more Twin Cast conversations, home selling tips, and real estate insights.
